requested_outputs: General conversion rate Gamma(E_a, k_a) for relativistic and non-relativistic axions, expressed via the dielectric function epsilon of the medium
(1) Gamma_NR for m_a = 25 eV and v_a = 1e-3, in eV
(2) Gamma_NR for m_a = 15 eV and v_a = 1e-3, in eV

regime: Zero-temperature conventional non-magnetic dielectric, no external electric field; axion coupled only via a F F-tilde; requested evaluations are non-relativistic (v_a = 1e-3 << 1) above the plasmon threshold E_a > omega_p or exactly at its boundary; the general relativistic rate formula is retained as requested output 1.

conventions.natural_units: hbar = c = 1; all quantities in eV
conventions.coupling: g = g_(a gamma gamma) = 1e-10 GeV^-1 converted exactly to 1e-19 eV^-1 (solver-local conversion, unit-tested)
conventions.dispersion: in-medium photon on shell q_gamma = n * omega_gamma with the given refractive index n (given-n approximation); energy conservation omega_gamma = E_a - omega_p
conventions.measure: photon final-state measure taken with the free-photon cut 2*pi*delta(q_gamma^2); the overall normalization of the rate follows from this choice; a residual one-power-of-n ambiguity relative to medium-modified phase-space conventions is recorded as a limitation (PROTOCOL 14.4, decision G-11), not resolved
conventions.plasmon_response: Im[-1/epsilon_L(omega,q)] = (pi/2)*omega_p*delta(omega - omega_p) (problem eq. A62): plasmon pole at omega = omega_p
conventions.j_kappa: J(kappa) = 2*pi*[(1+kappa^2)/(2*kappa^2) - (1-kappa^2)^2/(4*kappa^3)*ln((1+kappa)/|1-kappa|)], kappa = k_a/q_gamma; hand-derived limits J(0) = 8*pi/3 and J(1) = 2*pi, checked solver-locally against the closed form
conventions.nr_limit: E_a = m at leading order in v_a inside the NR prefactor (kinetic corrections O(v_a^2) ~ 5e-7 relative, below displayed precision; convention-insensitivity tested); the threshold gate is the exact rational test m > omega_p, which implies the physical condition E_a = m*(1+v_a^2/2) > omega_p; the razor-thin window omega_p/(1+v_a^2/2) < m <= omega_p (width O(v_a^2*omega_p) ~ 8 meV) where the exact kinematics is open but the leading-order prefactor (m - omega_p) is invalid is excluded by that same gate; no requested case lies inside it

assumptions.statement: The medium is a conventional non-magnetic solid-state material (mu = 1).
The medium is at zero temperature; no thermal populations enter the response.
There is no external electric field.
The axion interacts only via the a F F-tilde coupling to photons.
The medium enters solely through the longitudinal dielectric function epsilon_L with the plasmon-pole response (A62).
Each evaluated case has a definite axion mass (25 eV, 15 eV) at the common velocity v_a = 1e-3.

derivations.reason: Deriving Gamma(E_a,k_a) from the a F F-tilde coupling with the plasmon-pole response (A62) requires delta-collapse, tensor contraction with the medium projector, and a phase-space integral; the closed registry has no delta-distribution or integration rule (delta: capability UNAVAILABLE; integral/1: no consuming rule). The formula is hand-derived in the README and minted as a schematic relation/1; it is never claimed executable.

The kappa -> 0 limit J(0) = 8*pi/3 and the leading-order NR prefactor are asymptotic manipulations with no limit or series rule among the nine; hand-derived in the README (series expansion shown) and checked solver-locally against the closed-form J.

Substituting the five exact rational parameters into the bound-symbol NR formula and folding the all-rational tree to a single reduced Rational is executed by the closed registry and replayed byte-exactly by physmath.Replay (TestInfraDerivationReplay).

The Heaviside Theta has no rule among the nine (no comparison or step rule); the gate is an exact solver-local big.Rat comparison (axion.GammaNRExact: m > omega_p, implying the physical E_a > omega_p) with boundary and NR-window tests in protocol/derivation_test.go.

results.evidence: physmath.Replay re-executes EXPR-SUBSTITUTE-001 then EXPR-SIMPLIFY-001 from the bound premises (parameterized formula expression, declaring function, five exact rational inputs) and reproduces the declared rational byte-exactly (representation.ReplayCheck; TestInfraDerivationReplay; protocol.TestReplayAgreesWithLocalExact). The same value is obtained independently by solver-local exact arithmetic and agrees with the float64 general-formula evaluation to better than 1e-4 relative. Scope (PROTOCOL 10): replay establishes reproducibility of the recorded arithmetic steps under the closed rule registry; the rate formula itself is a hand derivation recorded as Represented, not established by protocol operations.

results.value: 0 eV (below the plasmon threshold: m = 15 eV < omega_p = 16.6 eV, and E_a = m(1+v_a^2/2) = 15.0000075 eV < omega_p)
results.evidence: solver-local exact big.Rat comparison implementing the leading-order Theta gate (axion.GammaNRExact: m > omega_p, implying E_a > omega_p; executed_by: solver-local; solver_local_computations sl_threshold_gate); threshold and NR-window boundary tests pass (protocol.TestThresholdBehavior). No Phys rule performs Heaviside steps: derivations[] threshold_gate is UNSUPPORTED, so no stronger Phys-attributable level exists for this claim.

limitations: Replay verifies only the recorded substitution and folding steps under the closed rule registry; the rate formula itself is a hand derivation (derivations general_rate_derivation and nr_limit_specialization: REPRESENTATIONAL ONLY) and is not established by protocol operations.

prefactor_normalization: the photon final-state measure convention (free-photon cut 2*pi*delta(q_gamma^2) with on-shell q_gamma = n*omega_gamma) leaves a residual one-power-of-n ambiguity in the overall normalization relative to medium-modified phase-space conventions (recorded as decision G-11, PROTOCOL 14.4); stated, not resolved.

NR convention: E_a = m is used in the exact rational prefactor; kinetic corrections are O(v_a^2) ~ 5e-7 relative. Threshold gate: exact m > omega_p (implies the physical E_a > omega_p); the razor-thin window omega_p/(1+v_a^2/2) < m <= omega_p, width O(v_a^2*omega_p) ~ 8 meV, where the exact kinematics is open but the leading-order prefactor (m - omega_p) is invalid, is excluded by the same gate; no requested case lies inside it. Convention insensitivity is tested to better than 1e-5 relative (protocol.TestConventionInsensitivity).

The full closed-form J(kappa) is evaluated only solver-locally in float64; the exact rational results use the analytic limit J(0) = 8*pi/3, with kappa ~ 1.98e-3 so the O(kappa^2) correction ~ 4e-6 relative is below the displayed 3 significant figures.
Unit handling is metadata only (PROTOCOL 9.1): no dimensional semantics exist in Phys; the GeV^-1 to eV^-1 conversion is solver-local and unit-tested.
